summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.90. Confirmed account takeover of privileged lab-admin account s.demir@aegean.edu. All sign-ins originate from Cloudvault VPS IP 45.142.10.9 in Frankfurt, Germany via the flagged vulnerable appliance vpn-edge-01, with no device_id recorded. A single MFA approval at 21:31:00 (mfa_prompt_count=1) is followed by seven successive successful portal/LMS logins with mfa_prompt_count=0, indicating MFA bypass/session reuse after initial approval. Rapid 5-minute alternating access to portal and LMS from a foreign VPS on a vulnerable appliance is inconsistent with legitimate use and constitutes a compromised privileged account requiring immediate containment.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
